snippet.title: Am I Nima Trailer - Convergence Showcase
snippet.description:
Am I Nima from Ho! Games is a psychological-horror game where you must convince your mom that you really are her daughter. Combine words together in your brain and use them to talk. Get her to trust you. Players must use their own intuition and deductive skills to search Nima’s brain and find words to direct the conversation, as well as discover combinations that reveal more of the story and unlock hidden memories.

This trailer was was part of the 2025 Convergence Gaming Showcase, and revealed the game is supported by Outersloth.

Wishlist it on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3224600/Am_I_Nima/
